In section *3.3 Method-based and result-based validation* of Ullman et al. 2021 (https://wires.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/widm.1444), we are interested in what is referred to as the validation method of "transferring" cluster labels to new data by a supervised classifier.
They point to this article: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2002.01822 which outlines some classifier-clustering algorithm pairs, however none quite correspond to SNF+spectral clustering.


Papers that seem to have done this sort of thing:

- https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38965514/
- https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33693803/
- https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15166017/
- https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36329798/
- https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28755001/
- https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27766943/ Cocaine addiction, neuroimaging data, density clustering -> SVM
